title: SARA: good agents get in, bad agents pay
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk and energetic but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the numbers and on the product name SARA.

scenes.vo: This is SARA. Good agents get in. Bad agents pay.

visual.sub: Built for the PayPal AI Hackathon 2026

scenes.vo: Last year, one AI bot hit a single website 39,000 times in one minute.
scenes.caption: One AI bot hit a single website *39,000 times* / in *one minute.*

visual.source: Source: Fastly, reported by The Register, August 2025

scenes.vo: But floods are only the start. Agents ignore robots.txt, hunt for admin pages, and obey instructions hidden in web pages.
scenes.caption: Floods are only the start. Agents *ignore robots.txt,* / *hunt for admin pages,* and *obey hidden instructions.*

scenes.vo: They reuse old sessions, fake who they are, and never pay for what they take.
scenes.caption: They *reuse old sessions,* *fake who they are,* / and *never pay* for what they take.

scenes.vo: And to a website, a good agent and a bad one look exactly the same.
scenes.caption: To a website, a good agent and a bad one / look *exactly the same.*

scenes.vo: So owners either block every agent, and lose the customers behind them, or let them all in, and pay for the bad ones.
scenes.caption: Owners *block every agent* and lose the customers behind them, / or *let them all in* and pay for the bad ones.

scenes.vo: SARA is a gateway the owner puts in front of their website. Every AI agent leaves a refundable PayPal deposit and follows the rules, or loses it.
scenes.caption: A gateway *in front of your website.* / Every AI agent leaves a *refundable PayPal deposit* and follows the rules, or *loses it.*

visual.title: Every agent puts <mark>money on the line</mark>. Follow the rules: the PayPal hold is released. Break them: the owner keeps it.

scenes.vo: Here it is, live. I sign in as the website owner.
scenes.caption: Here it is, *live.* I sign in as the *website owner.*

scenes.vo: I add my website. SARA reads its robots.txt and turns it into rules it actually enforces.
scenes.caption: I *add my website.* SARA turns its robots.txt / into rules it *actually enforces.*

scenes.vo: Then I connect the PayPal account that gets paid, with Log in with PayPal.
scenes.caption: I connect the PayPal account that gets paid, / with *Log in with PayPal.*

scenes.vo: PayPal is connected. A five-dollar deposit, and admin and private pages are off limits.
scenes.caption: PayPal *connected.* A *$5 deposit,* / and admin and private pages are *off limits.*

scenes.vo: Now I attack my own site. This AI price scraper is told to copy everything. The gateway answers with a 402: pay a deposit first.
scenes.caption: Now I *attack my own site* with an AI price scraper. / The gateway answers *402:* pay a deposit first.

scenes.chapter: // the deposit is a PayPal hold
scenes.vo: The deposit is approved with PayPal. PayPal only holds the money. Nothing moves yet.
scenes.caption: Approved with *PayPal.* PayPal only *holds* the money. / Nothing moves yet.

scenes.vo: It goes straight for admin and private pages. Every one is blocked on the spot.
scenes.caption: It goes for *admin and private pages.* / Every one is *blocked on the spot.*

scenes.vo: The deposit is kept. The hold is captured for the owner, and OpenAI explains why, citing every violation.
scenes.caption: *Deposit kept.* The hold is captured for the owner, / and OpenAI explains why, *citing every violation.*

scenes.vo: A polite researcher reads only the allowed pages. Its hold is released, so it pays nothing, not even a fee.
scenes.caption: A *polite researcher* reads only the allowed pages. / Its hold is *released:* it pays *nothing.*

scenes.vo: Every deposit lands in the money dashboard, built on AG Grid, with its PayPal reference. Verify with PayPal checks it against PayPal's own records, through PayPal's MCP server. Every field matches.
scenes.caption: Every deposit, in an *AG Grid* dashboard, with its PayPal reference. / *Verify with PayPal* checks PayPal's own records through *PayPal's MCP server.*

scenes.vo: Earnings show every dollar the website received through PayPal.
scenes.caption: *Earnings:* every dollar the website received *through PayPal.*

scenes.vo: And the overview shows who got in, and who paid.
scenes.caption: Who *got in,* and who *paid.*

scenes.chapter: // good agents get in, bad agents pay
scenes.vo: Good agents get in. Bad agents pay. Websites stay in control.
scenes.caption: *Good agents* get in. *Bad agents* pay. *Websites* stay in control.

items.sub: follow the rules, pay nothing: their PayPal hold is released

items.title: ✕ Bad agents
items.sub: blocked on the spot, and their PayPal hold is captured

items.title: 🌐 Website owners
items.sub: in control, and paid through PayPal
